🔥 बॉक्स ऑफिस पर मच गया तूफान, रामायण ने तोड़े सारे रिकॉर्ड! 🍿

नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म Ramayana ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर एक और बड़ा मुकाम हासिल कर लिया है।
फिल्म ने Dhurandhar के लाइफटाइम इंडिया नेट कलेक्शन को पीछे छोड़ दिया है और कुल कमाई 840 करोड़ रुपये के पार पहुंच गई है।
Sacnilk के मुताबिक, चौदहवें दिन फिल्म ने 23.20 करोड़ रुपये का नेट कलेक्शन किया है।
इसके साथ ही India में फिल्म का कुल नेट कलेक्शन 844.40 करोड़ रुपये हो गया है, जो देश भर के 21,215 शोज़ से आया है।
प्रड्यूसर Namit Malhotra का कहना है कि वे कहानी का ऐसा वर्जन दिखाना चाहते हैं जो इस स्केल और स्पेक्टकल पर पहले कभी नहीं देखा गया।
Ranbir Kapoor, Yash और Sai Pallavi स्टारर यह फिल्म IMAX के लिए शूट की गई है और इसका पहला पार्ट दिवाली पर रिलीज हुआ था।
क्या आपने अभी तक यह बड़ी फिल्म थिएटर्स में देखी है? 🎬

ctx.title: Ramayana box office collection day 14: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's film surpasses Dhurandhar's lifetime haul, crosses  ₹840 crore
ctx.summary: Ramayana Part 1 released in theatres on November 5 ahead of Diwali festivities. The film is helmed by Nitesh Tiwari and part 2 is scheduled for 2028 release.
ctx.text:
Nitesh Tiwari 's Ramayana has achieved another major box-office milestone, surpassing the lifetime India net collection of Dhurandhar as it crossed ₹ 840 crore. The film continues to draw audiences to theatres, even though the Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Yash-starrer saw a dip in its daily collection in second week.
On Day 14, Ramayana earned ₹ 23.20 crore net, according to Sacnilk. With its latest earnings, Ramayana has reached a total net collection in India of ₹ 844.40 crore. The film's day 14 collection came from 21,215 shows across the country. Interestingly, Dhurandhar The Revenge collected ₹ 20.10 crore on its fourteenth day whilst it was running in theatres from March 19 onwards. The Ranveer Singh-starrer collected ₹ 919.52 crore net in India in the first two weeks.
Earlier this month, producer Namit Malhotra spoke to news agency PTI about what he hopes to achieve with the film. "In India, there are a lot of questions like, 'Why are they making the Ramayana when there have been so many Ramayanas? We already know the story.' And I'm like, 'Listen, we're making it because we want to show you the version of this story that you've never seen.' No television show, no street play, no Ram Leela has ever shown you the Ramayana on this scale and with this spectacle that we are making...Much like an Avatar or an Avengers movie or think about Spider-Man or The Odyssey. We're putting Ramayana right up there next to all of those spectacles," Namit said.
Talking about the film's global ambitions, Namit added, “If you think about the West, they are the most potent audience for anything that's got a grand epic spectacle. And that's just not how Indian films have been made. So while India makes terrific Indian movies, whether it is 'Baahubali', 'Dhurandhar', or any of the big, super-duper hit films, they are not spectacles the way Hollywood thinks of spectacles. We are first trying to narrow that gap down and saying, 'If you can do it, we can do it too.' There's no reason for us to have any discrepancy. So, every person in Hollywood should acknowledge that India can also do something as good, if not bigger, than what they do.”
Starring Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi, Ramayana has seen strong audience interest since its release. The two-part adaptation follows Prince Rama (Ranbir Kapoor) and Sita (Sai Pallavi) during their exile, before Ravana's (Yash) abduction of Sita leads to the battle between good and evil. The film is produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios and Yash's Monster Mind Creations. Made for a global audience and filmed for IMAX, Part 1 arrived during the Diwali holiday period, while Part 2 is scheduled to release during Diwali 2027.
